title: Hagure Yuusha no Estetica: Hajirai Ippai
justification: AniList 15729 has 6 episodes (2012-09-26 to 2013-02-27); the AniList title is 'Hajirai Ippai'. AniDB 9015 S1-S6 are the 'Hajirai Ippai Original Video Vol.1-6' (A New Battle Suit?, What Does It Take to Be a Grown Woman?, Bound by the Holy Water..., Mixed Bath on the Shore, Ranking Battle Side Story..., The Beautiful Demon Warrior, Miu) on 2012-09-26, 10-24, 11-28, 12-26, 2013-01-30, 02-27. The parent's offset-1 row puts them on TVDB 259649 0x02-0x07, 'Embarrassing Original Video Vol. 1..6' with the same subtitles and dates; 0x01 is the Queen's Blade crossover. TMDB tv/62171 S0E2-7 agree.
